name: verify_handback
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
p=Path.cwd();h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();m=json.loads((p/'manifest.json').read_text())
for n,v in m['sha256'].items():assert h((p/n).read_bytes())==v,n
r=h((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes());assert r=='5434323e40e8d6e0096bc53e5ace4c71f2a1559e186dbc3cf7bad738f25110a8'
for n in ['manifest.json','inventory_manifest.receipt.json','inventory_manifest.output.txt','bootstrap-receipt.json']:print('VERIFIED_SHA256',n,h((p/n).read_bytes()))
print('HANDOFF',len(m['sha256']),'actual file hashes verified; reservation unchanged; exactly20 outcomes; credit0;52/60 unchanged. Own final receipt/output self-excluded. All child jobs reaped by supplied runner.')
